remarks.para:
1. For highlighters constructed on , modifications to range might not cause those highlighters to be added to either collection (, , ). See: https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/VSCI-586.
Because VSCode requires a full snapshot of all highlighters during each publish, we cache all highlighters currently present in the document—not just those added, removed, or modified since the last publish.

2. Since diagnostics are published from a background thread, we cannot guarantee that highlighters are still valid at the time of publishing. Tooltip generation requires a valid highlighter, so we cache the tooltip in this method while the highlighter is still valid.

summary.para: The position encodings supported by the client. Client and server have to agree on the same position encoding to ensure that offsets (e.g. character position in a line) are interpreted the same on both side.

To keep the protocol backwards compatible the following applies: if the value 'utf-16' is missing from the array of position encodings servers can assume that the client supports UTF-16. UTF-16 is therefore a mandatory encoding.

Implementation considerations: since the conversion from one encoding into another requires the content of the file / line the conversion is best done where the file is read which is usually on the server side.
